newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA RE-ELECT NUNEZ AS PRESIDENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA RE-ELECT NUNEZ AS PRESIDENT.

text.p: Barcelona football club re-elected their long-standing president Josep Lluis Nunez on Sunday for a further five- year term, Spanish state radio reported.
Nunez, who has been president of the club for 19 years, won an overwhelming victory, with 24,025 votes -- 76 percent of the total.
The other candidate, Angel Fernandez, who ran an election campaign calling for change, won 5,209 votes, 16.5 percent.
Just over 33 percent of nearly 92,000 club members who were called to vote turned up at the ballot boxes on Sunday.
